title: ChatterExtensionConfig - Data API
description: Configuration for the Chatter extension for Experience Cloud sites. This object is available in API version 41.0 and later.

CanCreate.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
CanCreate.description: Determines whether the ChatterExtension can create an instance that appears by rendering.

CanRead.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
CanRead.description: Determines whether the ChatterExtension can be viewed.

ChatterExtensionId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ChatterExtensionId.description: The ID of the ChatterExtension. This is a relationship field.

NetworkId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
NetworkId.description: The ID of the Experience Cloud site where the ChatterExtension is deployed.

Position.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Position.description: The position of the ChatterExtension icon in the Chatter publisher.
